summary: quickstart commands did not run verbatim (external audit)
root_cause: ai/faq.md was written from memory of the intended CLI, not from the argparse definition: init got a phantom --agent flag, evidence used a nonexistent 'add' subcommand, register and keygen steps were missing
detection: independent external audit (fresh clone, outsider persona, verbatim execution)
fix: faq rewritten command-by-command against cli.py and re-verified end-to-end
lesson: docs are code: generate or verify every command against the real parser before publishing; a broken quickstart is a broken front door
